name: memo-bridge
description: Private MCP for Memo Labs: inspect a Mac and a Netcup VPS read-only, browse registered projects, and coordinate parallel AI work sessions on GitHub Issues (workspaces, shared Issue leases, Git-verified checkpoints) without relying on the Sentinel X commercial hub.

interface.shortDescription: Mac + VPS status and work coordination
interface.longDescription: Inspect the Memo Labs Mac and VPS with fixed read-only probes, list registered projects, and coordinate work between sessions: open a workspace, claim a GitHub Issue through the shared Memo Labs lease ledger, record pushed checkpoints. No shell, no project file writes, no merge. Requires a local Mac runtime, python3, a logged-in gh, and SSH access to the VPS.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the status of my Mac and VPS through Memo Bridge.
